name: NuGet
description: Add registry feeds as package sources to NuGet.Config, with credentials in the file or the environment

mode.label: Where credentials are stored
mode.help: file: the password is written into NuGet.Config as ClearTextPassword (mode 0600). env: NuGet.Config only lists the source, the credential is exported as NuGetPackageSourceCredentials_<name> from a shell environment file (mode 0600).

sourceName.label: Package source name
sourceName.help: Key of the package source in NuGet.Config. Empty: the instance name with underscores for hyphens. The option sourceName of an instance wins; with several instances, set it there.

defaultSource.label: Default source
defaultSource.help: Written together with a new NuGet.Config or a new packageSources section, so that public packages stay available. Empty: no default source.

envFile.label: Shell environment file
envFile.help: Exports the NuGetPackageSourceCredentials_* variables in mode env.

sourceName.label: Package source name
sourceName.help: Key of the package source in NuGet.Config. Mode env allows letters, digits and underscores only.
